choices.ja: みなさんこんにちは！新しく来ました。

responses.author: Nova Orbit
responses.text: A new human has arrived. Interesting.
responses.translation: 新しい人間が来た。興味深い。

responses.author: Coffee Goblin
responses.text: Welcome to our little corner of the internet!
responses.translation: ネットの片隅のこの場所へようこそ！

choices.ja: ジャズが好きな人はいる？

responses.author: Jazz Cat
responses.text: YES! You found the right place!
responses.translation: もちろん！ここに来て正解だよ！

responses.author: Mika Reed
responses.translation: 私はサックスを吹いてるよ。ようこそ！

choices.ja: ちょっと緊張している。

responses.author: Wise Owl
responses.translation: 大丈夫。ゆっくりでいいよ。

responses.author: Nova Orbit
responses.text: I was nervous on Earth, too.
responses.translation: 私も地球では緊張したよ。

events.author: Mika Reed
events.prompt: It is raining in Bellwindport again. Do you like rainy days?
events.translation: Bellwindportはまた雨。雨の日は好き？

choices.answer: Then you would love Bellwindport!
choices.answerJa: それならBellwindportが気に入るはず！
choices.easyAnswer: Then you would love Bellwindport!

choices.answer: Me too. I miss the sun!
choices.answerJa: 私も。太陽が恋しい！
choices.easyAnswer: Me too. I miss the sun!

choices.answer: That is a good way to see it!
choices.answerJa: いい考え方だね！
choices.easyAnswer: That is a good way to see it!

events.author: Nova Orbit
events.translation: どうして人間は誕生日をお祝いするの？

choices.answer: Every Earth day is special to me.
choices.answerJa: 私には地球の毎日が特別だよ。
choices.easyAnswer: Every Earth day is special to me.

choices.answer: Ah. This explains many things.
choices.answerJa: なるほど。いろいろ説明がつく。
choices.easyAnswer: Ah. This explains many things.

choices.ja: 幸せな気持ちになるから。
choices.answer: Happiness is a good reason.
choices.answerJa: 幸せはいい理由だね。
choices.easyAnswer: Happiness is a good reason.

events.author: Wise Owl
events.translation: 今日はどんな一日だった？

choices.answer: I'm glad to hear that.
choices.answerJa: それはよかった。
choices.easyAnswer: I'm glad to hear that.

choices.answer: Please get some rest.
choices.answerJa: 少し休んでね。
choices.easyAnswer: Please get some rest.

choices.answer: Quiet days can be good, too.
choices.answerJa: 静かな日もいいものだよ。
choices.easyAnswer: Quiet days can be good, too.

events.author: Jazz Cat
events.prompt: Tell me one song you like!

choices.answer: Now we are talking!
choices.answerJa: そうこなくっちゃ！
choices.easyAnswer: Now we are talking!

choices.answer: Good music is good music!
choices.answerJa: いい音楽はいい音楽だよ！
choices.easyAnswer: Good music is good music!

choices.answer: I have a playlist for that.
choices.answerJa: それ用のプレイリストがあるよ。
choices.easyAnswer: I have a playlist for that.

events.author: Mika Reed
events.prompt: Hey! Can I tell you about my new song?
events.translation: ねえ！新しい曲の話をしてもいい？

choices.answer: Thanks! I'm practicing a Charlie Parker tune.
choices.answerJa: ありがとう！チャーリー・パーカーの曲を練習してるんだ。
choices.easyAnswer: Thanks! I'm practicing a Charlie Parker tune.

choices.answer: No problem. Talk soon!
choices.answerJa: 大丈夫。また話そうね！
choices.easyAnswer: No problem. Talk soon!

events.author: Nova Orbit
events.prompt: I need advice about human friendship.
events.translation: 人間の友情について相談がある。

choices.answer: I will write that down.
choices.answerJa: それをメモしておく。
choices.easyAnswer: I will write that down.

choices.answer: I must study jokes next.
choices.answerJa: 次はジョークを研究しなければ。
choices.easyAnswer: I must study jokes next.

choices.answer: An excellent Earth rule.
choices.answerJa: 素晴らしい地球のルールだ。
choices.easyAnswer: An excellent Earth rule.

events.author: Wise Owl
events.prompt: My friend seems sad. What should I say?
events.translation: 友達が悲しそう。何て言えばいいかな？

choices.answer: Simple and kind. Thank you.
choices.answerJa: シンプルで優しいね。ありがとう。
choices.easyAnswer: Simple and kind. Thank you.

choices.ja: ただ話を聞いてあげて。
choices.answer: Sometimes listening is enough.
choices.answerJa: 聞くだけで十分なこともあるね。
choices.easyAnswer: Sometimes listening is enough.

events.easyPrompt: My friend is sad. Any ideas?

events.author: Mika Reed
events.prompt: I recorded a song, but I'm scared to share it. What do you think?
events.translation: 曲を録音したけど公開するのが怖い。どう思う？

choices.ja: 公開したほうがいいよ！
choices.answer: Maybe I will. Thanks for believing in me!
choices.answerJa: そうしようかな。信じてくれてありがとう！
choices.easyAnswer: Maybe I will. Thanks for believing in me!

choices.answer: You're right. I can share it when I'm ready.
choices.answerJa: そうだね。準備ができたら公開するよ。
choices.easyAnswer: You're right. I can share it when I'm ready.

events.easyPrompt: I made a song. Is it good?

events.author: Nova Orbit
events.prompt: I think I made my first Earth friend. Is this how friendship feels?
events.translation: 初めて地球の友達ができた気がする。友情ってこういう感じ？

choices.ja: そうだよ！友達としてようこそ！
choices.answer: I am experiencing a new emotion. Thank you.
choices.answerJa: 新しい感情を経験している。ありがとう。
choices.easyAnswer: I am experiencing a new emotion. Thank you.

choices.ja: 友情は時間とともに育つよ。
choices.answer: Then I will be patient.
choices.answerJa: では気長に待とう。
choices.easyAnswer: Then I will be patient.

events.author: Jazz Cat
events.prompt: We're having an online music party! Want to join?
events.translation: オンライン音楽パーティーをするよ！参加する？

choices.answer: Awesome! Mika is bringing her sax!
choices.answerJa: 最高！Mikaはサックスを持ってくるよ！
choices.easyAnswer: Awesome! Mika is bringing her sax!

choices.answer: Of course! Everyone is welcome.
choices.answerJa: もちろん！誰でも歓迎だよ。
choices.easyAnswer: Of course! Everyone is welcome.

events.easyPrompt: We have a music party! Join us?

events.author: Rosie Pan
events.prompt: Hi! I tried a new soup recipe today. Want to hear about it?
events.translation: 今日は新しいスープを作ってみたの。聞いてみる？

choices.answer: I added fresh herbs at the end. The whole kitchen smelled wonderful!
choices.answerJa: 最後に新鮮なハーブを入れたの。台所じゅういい香り！
choices.easyAnswer: I added fresh herbs at the end. The whole kitchen smelled wonderful!

choices.answer: Of course! The kitchen will still be here.
choices.answerJa: もちろん！台所はいつでもここにあるよ。
choices.easyAnswer: Of course! The kitchen will still be here.

events.author: Mika Reed
events.prompt: Remember that Charlie Parker tune? I finally played it at the club!
events.translation: あのチャーリー・パーカーの曲、覚えてる？ついにクラブで演奏したよ！

choices.answer: I missed one note, but the audience smiled. I had a great time.
choices.answerJa: 一音間違えたけど、お客さんが笑顔だった。楽しかったよ。
choices.easyAnswer: I missed one note, but the audience smiled. I had a great time.

choices.answer: Thanks! I was nervous until the first chorus.
choices.answerJa: ありがとう！最初のコーラスまでは緊張してた。
choices.easyAnswer: Thanks! I was nervous until the first chorus.

events.author: Clara Strings
events.prompt: Hello from Brookside! I found a lovely little music shop today.
events.translation: ブルックサイドからこんにちは！今日はすてきな小さな楽器店を見つけたよ。

choices.answer: Old sheet music, violin strings, and a very sleepy cat.
choices.answerJa: 古い楽譜とバイオリンの弦と、とても眠そうな猫がいたよ。
choices.easyAnswer: Old sheet music, violin strings, and a very sleepy cat.

choices.answer: It was. I stayed longer than I planned.
choices.answerJa: そうなの。思ったより長居しちゃった。
choices.easyAnswer: It was. I stayed longer than I planned.

events.author: Ollie
events.prompt: Can I ask you something? What made you smile today?
events.translation: ひとつ聞いてもいい？今日は何を見て笑顔になった？

choices.answer: I like that answer. Those moments stay with us.
choices.answerJa: その答え、好きだな。そういう瞬間は心に残るね。
choices.easyAnswer: I like that answer. Those moments stay with us.

choices.answer: Music can make an ordinary day feel special.
choices.answerJa: 音楽は普通の日を特別にしてくれるね。
choices.easyAnswer: Music can make an ordinary day feel special.

events.author: Rosie Pan
events.prompt: A customer asked for the soup you helped me talk about. It is on our menu now!
events.translation: この前話したスープをお客さんが注文してくれたよ。今はメニューにあるんだ！
events.easyPrompt: The soup is on our menu!

choices.answer: I am keeping the recipe in my favorite notebook.
choices.answerJa: お気に入りのノートにレシピを書いておくね。
choices.easyAnswer: I am keeping the recipe in my favorite notebook.

choices.answer: More than I expected. That makes me happy.
choices.answerJa: 思った以上にね。嬉しいな。
choices.easyAnswer: More than I expected. That makes me happy.
